_source: Static UI keys for the mobile work-period delivery screen (route field-progress, pototype/mobile-screens.jsx MFieldProgress L316-358). KEYS ONLY — never a translation. MIXED LAYERS (the approvals_inbox / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent): fields marked dict below are stable ids read with t(); the rest are the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key, read with tp(). NEAR-TOTAL ZERO-MINT: labelSubcon=subcon.subcontractor 'ผู้รับเหมา' is byte-exact with the prototype's contractor line label (L323) · progressTitle=subcon.colProgressLong 'ความคืบหน้า' is the first half of the prototype's section title (L326 'ความคืบหน้างวด 3' — the '3' is mock data and the ordinal is composed at runtime from the REAL work_period.seq around unitPeriod=accept.unitPhase 'งวด', the same client-side composition apps/api/src/routes/subcon.ts L513-518 explicitly leaves to the FE) · statusLabel=common.status 'สถานะ' labels what renders WHERE THE PROTOTYPE RENDERS A PERCENTAGE (L331): a work period carries a status, not a completion percentage, so the number is an em-dash and the real column takes its place — see field_progress_agg.dart and BLOCKERS.md B-297. That status VALUE is a WIRE enum (pending|delivered|inspecting|passed|rejected|paid are English machine codes) and is NEVER rendered raw in this Thai-only field app — §0 rule 2. It resolves through four EXISTING dict keys, ZERO-MINT, using the merged WEB port's own 6→4 collapse (apps/web/src/screens/subcon/subcon-accept-rows.ts mapPeriodStatus L196-217 + its key map subcon-accept.tsx L108-113) so the two clients cannot describe the same period differently: statusNotReached=subcon.statusNotReached 'ยังไม่ถึง' (pending) · statusRequested=subcon.statusRequested 'ขอตรวจรับ' (delivered|inspecting) · statusAccepted=subcon.kpiAccepted 'ตรวจรับแล้ว' (passed|paid) · statusRejected=subcon.rejectBtn 'ตีกลับแก้ไข' (rejected). One deliberate departure from the web: an UNKNOWN status resolves to NO key and renders an em-dash, where the web folds it into 'ยังไม่ถึง' — 'not reached yet' is a claim, and a status this build does not know is not evidence for it · deliver=wo.form.deliverWork 'ส่งมอบงาน' labels the sticky CTA, which performs the REAL POST /periods/{id}/deliver; the prototype's own label 'ขออนุมัติงวด · 645,000 ฿' (L353) is NOT keyed because its money half is a hardcoded amount and money = SERVER · the three honest offline-write states borrow the SAME generic dict strings pm_checkin/pm_checklist/pm_notes borrowed rather than inventing wording — BLOCKERS.md B-268 (ก): sent=labor.att.savedBadge 'บันทึกแล้ว', queued=tax.etax.statusPending 'รอส่ง', failed=admin.common.actionFailedToast · empty=boq.edEmptyRowsFilter 'ไม่พบรายการที่ตรงกับตัวกรอง' for a genuinely empty list (an UNREADABLE list renders an em-dash and no key at all — the two are different states and must stay different). One phrase slot ALREADY EXISTS in the sacred phrases layer and is reused zero-mint: labelWork 'งาน' (L324). ONE value is net-new and is staged in agents/orch-d-recon/field-group-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (docs/extract/i18n-full.json is untouched by this slice): title 'บันทึกความคืบหน้า' (L319). It already resolves in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th — the merged-screen precedent) and lights up en/zh/ar once applied. NOT REPRESENTED HERE — three prototype sections are DROPPED rather than keyed, because each is an affordance with nothing behind it in EITHER direction: (1) the progress bar + 'เดิม 65%' / '+13 ppt วันนี้' (L328-334) have no completion column and may not be synthesised from a count of delivered periods (periods are deliberately unequal in size — that is what the four bases mean); (2) the photo grid (L337-346) — the app has no image picker or upload seam AND the periods read returns no acceptance, so no photo can be captured or read; (3) the note section (L347-349) — neither work_period nor acceptance has a note column anywhere in the schema, so an em-dashed note would imply one exists and is merely unknown. The work line's LABEL is kept (chrome) and its VALUE is an em-dash: subcon_contract has no scope/description column.
_layers: dict (t): labelSubcon · progressTitle · unitPeriod · statusLabel · statusNotReached · statusRequested · statusAccepted · statusRejected · deliver · sent · queued · failed · empty. phrases (tp): title · labelWork.
